title: Make native Ninja provisioning retry or fall back from winget gateway failures
body: The queued native Debug build failed before configure or compilation because build.bat provision invoked winget and received an HTTP 504 gateway timeout. Recovery manually downloaded the pinned Ninja 1.13.1 archive from the official GitHub release into VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain/downloads/Ninja-build.Ninja/1.13.1/ninja-win.zip, then reran the native build successfully. The provisioner should retry transient winget failures and/or use a documented direct archive fallback so native lanes do not hand-stage pinned tool archives. Failed queue log: /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1794209547-build-cx-winport3:build-debug.log.

title: Make vixen-native build configure an unconfigured native tree
body: The queued command tools/vixen-native.sh --lane lane-winport3 --branch lane-winport3 build build vixen-ninja failed before target work because it invoked CMake against /mnt/c/vixen-native/lane-winport3/build/ninja, which was not a directory. Recovery used the same launcher with build all vixen-ninja, which performs configure plus build and completed the full native Debug witness. The wrapper should detect a missing native binary tree and configure automatically, or make the action semantics explicit in its documented native build contract.
